ruleDefinitions.name: Csc.EXE Execution Form Potentially Suspicious Parent
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a potentially suspicious parent of "csc.exe", which could be a sign of payload delivery.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\csc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "csc\.exe") AND ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\onenote\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Encoded\\ .*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*FromBase64String.*"))) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX("([Pp]rogram[Dd]ata|%([Ll]ocal)?[Aa]pp[Dd]ata%|\[Aa]pp[Dd]ata\([Ll]ocal([Ll]ow)?|[Rr]oaming))\[^\]{1,256}$") OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Pictures\\\\.*")))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\")) OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\sdiagnhost\.exe" OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\inetsrv\\w3wp\.exe") AND  NOT (parent_process_path = "C\:\\ProgramData\\chocolatey\\choco\.exe" OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\ Advanced\\ Threat\\ Protection.*") OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*JwB7ACIAZgBhAGkAbABlAGQAIgA6AHQAcgB1AGUALAAiAG0AcwBnACIAOgAiAEEAbgBzAGkAYgBsAGUAIAByAGUAcQB1AGkAcgBlAHMAIABQAG8AdwBlAHIAUwBoAGUAbABsACAAdgAzAC4AMAAgAG8AcgAgAG4AZQB3AGUAcgAiAH0AJw.*") OR
